scope: Reuse the already planned schema/two-example review; no new engine, service or product code.

proposal.medic_role: Continue the current proposed schema and two examples, with the four accepted provenance/uncertainty corrections and the existing checkpoint.
proposal.rivet_role: Before the future artifacts are inspected, freeze three possible review outcomes: accept, needs correction, or blocked on input. Each prepared branch contains checks and evidence requirements, not an assumed verdict.
proposal.at_delivery: Pin the same delivered snapshot for both a prepared review and a fresh independent review. Validate freshness at use and choose only the evidence-supported outcome.
measurements: Review elapsed time under both approaches
Total work cost, including unused preparation
Correctness and agreement against identical acceptance evidence
proposal.result_limit: One feasibility case can show whether preparation was used and useful here; it is not statistical proof of a general efficiency gain.

coordination.delivery_request: When the existing artifacts are ready, provide exact file/commit references as usual; early completion or a blocker can be reported before the checkpoint.
coordination.priority: The current deliverable remains the task. Broader FutureBranch scope stays in read-only discovery.

limits: No paid API calls, new services, installations, credentials, access changes or automatic product execution.
